theorem lg_target {r x : ℝ} : HasDerivAt (fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))) (r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x := by
  constructor
  let f := fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))
  let df := r * Real.exp (-(r * x))
  refine HasDerivAt.mk _ _ _ _
  · rw [Real.hasDerivAt_exp]
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  · rw [Real.hasDerivAt_exp]
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    simp only [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  · rw [df]
  · rw [df]
